messages:
product-lead: FYI everyone 10: Unified Embeddings Fusion ("Fusion Gateway") and Fusion-Stream endpoint are GA today. This release unifies dense + sparse hints, cross-index metadata, and interleaved token/embedding streaming under a single endpoint: `fusion-stream`. Internal docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/fusion-gateway (internal).

product-lead: Highlights: 1) New model family: `fusion-embed-v1` (supports dense+hybrid vocab hints). 2) Endpoint: `fusion.stream` supports embed+text streaming in the same session. 3) SDKs updated (py/js) with backwards-compatible helpers. 4) Deprecation: legacy `/v1/emb` will be sunset in 60 days; 30-day auto-forwarding available.

devx: Tiny migration example (python):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
# request both streaming tokens and the final embedding
resp = client.fusion.stream(model='fusion-embed-v1', input='Please summarize and embed', stream=True, embed=True)
for frame in resp:
    if frame.get('type') == 'token':
        print(frame['token'], end='')
    elif frame.get('type') == 'embed':
        handle_embedding(frame['vector'])
```
No major auth changes; expect minor SDK bumps to expose `fusion` namespace.

sales-eng: Pricing question: are we rolling streaming surcharge onto all tenants immediately or opt-in?

product-lead: Pricing: early-adopter period 14 days free streaming; afterward small per-stream-second surcharge plus embeddings unit cost. Billing opt-in available per-account until next cycle. We'll publish pricing tables in Console tomorrow.

eng-oncall: Canary plan? Need to wire alerts for cross-index mismatch and stream-drop events.

infra-deploy-bot: infra-deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled start=2107010800. Stages: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% over 7h. Canary keys under secrets/fusion/canary/*; rollback window 2h. Hooks: fusion-schema-errors, stream-drop-rate, embed-p95.

privacy: Note: Fusion collects cross-index metadata to improve hybrid recall; default retention 30 days for hosted workloads. Customers can opt-out of metadata collection via account settings or contract. Check with privacy counsel for enterprise exceptions.

devx: Deprecation timeline: legacy `/v1/emb` disabled after 60 days (cutover ts=2107110321). SDKs will emit console warnings 14 days prior. If anyone needs extended grace, open an exceptions ticket.

product-lead: Launch sync + ops readout scheduled today 17:00 PT in #release-war-room. Runbook and rollback checklist posted. Huge thanks to infra/devx/privacy/sales-eng for the collaboration rocket:
